import sys

scaling = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(scaling)
rows = []
for repeat in (1, 2, 3):
    budgets = (4, 8) if repeat % 2 else (8, 4)
    versions = ("before", "after") if repeat % 2 else ("after", "before")
    for cores in budgets:
        for version in versions:
            binary = (raw / "interop-before.test"
                      if version == "before" else raw / "interop-after.test")
            for kind in ("duplex", "upload", "download", "paced"):
                name = f"control-n{cores}-r{repeat}-{version}-{kind}"
                log = raw / f"{name}.log"
                env = os.environ.copy()
                env.update(XRAY_HYSTERIA_CLIENT_WORKERS="4",
                           XRAY_HYSTERIA_SERVER_WORKERS="4",
                           XHYS_SCALING_POOL="2" if cores == 4 else "4", XRAY_NET_DIAG="0")
                command = [
                    sys.executable, str(repo / "native/libxhysteria/bench-scaling.py"),
                    "--measure", "taskset", "-c", ",".join(map(str, range(4, 4 + cores))),
                    str(binary), "-test.run", "^$", "-test.bench",
                    f"^{scaling.BENCHMARKS[kind]}/native$", "-test.benchtime",
                    f"{scaling.SIZES[kind]}x", "-test.cpu", str(cores),
                    "-test.count", "1", "-test.timeout", "120s"]

                    argv=command, binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),

                    loadavg=os.getloadavg()), indent=2) + "\n")
                with log.open("w") as stream:
                    subprocess.run(command, env=env, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                   check=True, timeout=140)
                metrics = scaling.parse_log(log)
                assert metrics["iterations"] == scaling.SIZES[kind]
                assert metrics["tcp-flows"] == 32
                assert metrics["native-client-engines"] == (2 if cores == 4 else 4)
                rows.append(dict(cores=cores, repeat=repeat, revision=version,
                                 kind=kind, metrics=metrics, log=log.name))

(raw / "control-results.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + "\n")
